title: Beavers Built a Dam Nearly 3,000 Feet Long

scenes.text: Beavers built a dam you can see from space.
It's in Wood Buffalo National Park in northern Alberta, Canada.
The dam is about 850 metres long, or 2,800 feet.
A scientist spotted it on satellite images in 2007, and nobody had ever mapped it.
It was probably started in the mid-1970s, and the beavers are still adding to it.
Beaver dams are among the few animal-made things visible from orbit.
